_comment: 4 groups whose Sigma_t spans three decades (0.1, 1, 10, 100) with within-group scattering ratios 0.5, 0.6, 0.9, 0.99 and downscatter into the next group down only, so the group sweep stays exact. Material 1 is a 5x density-scaled copy of material 0: every Sigma_t[g]/Sigma_t[0] ratio is 5 times larger in absolute terms but IDENTICAL as a ratio, which is what makes a per-cell reference removal exact per group where a scalar shift cannot be. Shared by slab_decades4.json and box_decades4.json.
